meta.title: Ask User as Subagent
meta.description: Lets the agent hand a task to you, the user, through a timed task card; a delegation-bias setting decides how readily it does so, and a free-text description tells the agent what this subagent is.

delegationBias.title: Delegation bias
delegationBias.description: 0 keeps the agent working on its own; 100 makes it look for every reasonable chance to hand a task to you.

timeoutSeconds.title: Wait limit (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long the agent waits for your answer before the call settles as a timeout. 0 waits indefinitely.

subagentDescription.title: Describe this subagent to the main agent
subagentDescription.description: Text added to the main agent's system prompt as a description of this subagent: what it is good at, and what kind of task to hand it. Empty leaves the default framing.
